sm_count_provenance: MEASURED live from the 5060 manifests (Tree B canonical_features / cache_predictor). Corrects the guessed value 50 still carried by cache_predictor._SM_COUNT_BY_ARCH['sm_120'] in the codex source — the ArchProfile supersedes it. See MERGE_PROVENANCE.md.
griddim_penalty_alpha_note: uncalibrated opt-out (sm120_uncalibrated): the model refuses to extrapolate the sm_86 0.110 penalty to Blackwell.

l2_geometry.provenance: capacity + slice count runtime-derived (run_suite cc==12 branch, _STATIC_CARD_L2_BYTES['sm_120-laptop']=32 MiB); full policy/replacement geometry not characterised.

l1_geometry.reason: The Blackwell L1/TEX geometry row is ABSENT in both trees (l1_static_card_table.json has no sm_120 entry); the L1 walker fail-closes. This is the single biggest per-arch data gap.

nvml_reference_operating_point.reason: No sm_120 NVML reference operating point or short-burst anchor was captured; the GA102 1350/2130 bands are wrong for a 5060 laptop.

duration_crosswalk.reason: sm_120 duration labels exist (CUPTI dual-source, 9 cells) but no NCU-time reference / crosswalk was captured on the 5060, so the deploy-ns observable is uncertified there.

dram_bandwidth.reason: no locked operating point exists on the laptop part (DVFS span 15.34x, 180-2762 MHz) and the GDDR7 bus-width x data-rate pair was never verified against a locked clock — a bytes-per-SM-cycle covariate is undefined until the measurement protocol pins one

predictor_state.l2_sector_hit_rate: REFUTED — L1->L2 miss filter is inert because bare_ldg_e_default is unknown_typed_unavailable (Blackwell LDG.E / LDG.E.U16.CONSTANT / descriptor loads route to OTHER/bypass); learned v5 head 0.0755 and mechanistic replay 0.358 both exceed the 0.055 gate.
predictor_state.l1tex_sector_hit_rate: uncalibrated — no sm_120 L1 head; 0 of 26 cells scored (no denominator).
predictor_state.wall_clock: REFUTED — OLS-on-log10(duration) SMAPE 1.766 does not beat shape_size_only 0.891; NVML covariates worsen the fit; DVFS span 15.34x (180-2762 MHz).

notes: This card is deliberately partial. Fields marked status=research_gap were never captured on the local Blackwell part; consumers MUST fail closed on them and never substitute sm_86 values (loader.is_research_gap()).

The two build-only tokens sm_120a / sm_120f live in build_arch_family, NOT as deploy arch_ids; the deploy/label arch_id is the bare sm_120 (keeps the frozen 30-cell cohort and label_admitted arch enum byte-stable).
